description: This file defines the interface 'DownstreamSenderFactory' which provides factory methods to create or retrieve clients for sending telemetry and event data to Hono's southbound APIs. It includes static methods for creating or retrieving senders wrapped in futures, maintaining connection lifecycle considerations.

classes.name: DownstreamSenderFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating clients for Hono's southbound Telemetry and Event APIs, extending connection lifecycle management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new DownstreamSenderFactory using an existing HonoConnection.

methods.name: getOrCreateTelemetrySender
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing telemetry sender client for a given tenant, returning a Future that completes when the link is established.

methods.name: getOrCreateEventSender
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an existing event sender client for a given tenant, returning a Future that completes when the link is established.
